source_document.body:
It’s the second and last day of Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days event, and we’ve got another deal-packed smorgasbord of Green Deals for you, with all the others we couldn’t fit here collected into our Fall Prime Day Green Deals hub here . Starting off today’s edition is Jackery’s full Fall Prime Day Sale with up to 65% discounts and bonus savings codes, with it offering the 3,584Wh HomePower 3600 Pro Max Power Station at a new $1,664 low , while Bluetti has a number of units at up to 50% off , including the 1,024Wh Elite 100 V2 Power Station at $449 . There is also the MASSIVE array of Anker security device deals at up to 50% off starting from $18 for some of the best prices we’ve seen yet, as well as ECOVACS’ O1000 and A2000 LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mowers at new lows starting from $949 . We also have more on Segway’s Max G2 e-scooter, a new low price on a carbon-fiber EGO Multi-Head Combo kit, a roundup of all the Worx tool deals, Beatbot’s returning low prices on robot pool cleaners, Anker’s Nebula portable projectors, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Jackery’s full Fall Prime Day Sale drops 3,584Wh HomePower 3600 Pro Max power station to new $1,664 low ($435 off), more
Alongside the Amazon Prime Big Deal Days Sale , the Jackery Fall Prime Day Sale is offering up to 65% discounts on power stations, with three tiers of bonus extra savings for orders over $1,500. One inclusion hitting a new low price is the latest HomePower 3600 Pro Max Portable Power Station down at $1,664 shipped , after using the code FALL3 at checkout, beating Amazon by $35 . Down from $2,099 to $1,799 in early Prime Day savings, savings have increased here to $1,714, which only gets better with the bonus savings code for an additional $50 off. The combined $435 markdown beats out the previous $1,699 low from June’s Prime Day, giving you the best price we have tracked since it released in June.
You can browse the full lineup of deals in our original coverage here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Anker security cameras, smart locks, baby monitors, sensors, item finders, more up to 50% off during Prime Day from $18
With Amazon’s Fall Prime Day Sale in full momentum now, if you’ve been holding off on upgrading your home security, now’s an ideal time to do so with the massive amount of Anker eufy security device deals we’re seeing (up to 50% off). Some notable inclusions we spotted are the brand’s tried-and-true SoloCam S220 Solar Security Camera multi-pack options starting down at $56.99 shipped , as well as the far more comprehensive (and new) NVR System E50 4K Dual-Lens 8-Cam Kit with a 4TB hub at a new $1,300 low from $1,900, and the Security Smart Lock C220 that offers six entry options down at its $90 low .
You can check out the full and massive lineup of deals on other cameras, smart locks, baby monitors, sensors, item finders, and more in our original coverage here .
Amazon offers up to 50% Fall Prime Day savings on Bluetti power stations: 1,024Wh Elite 100 V2 down at $449, more from $400
As part of the ongoing Amazon Prime Big Deal Days event, you can find a number of Bluetti’s most popular power stations getting up to 50% discounts. One of the top picks among the group is the 1,024Wh Elite 100 V2 Portable Power Station down at $448.99 shipped , beating out the brand’s direct website by $40 . While mid-September did see it climb up to an $899 rate, it’s more often been down around $499 since August. The deal here gives you a solid $50 markdown off the recent going rate (and $400 off the highest price we’ve tracked), landing it just $54 above the annual low. We’ve rounded up the brand’s other popular picks for you below.
Bluetti’s top Prime Big Deal Days picks:
Elite 100 mini (1,004.8Wh) power station: $400 (Reg. $699)
AC180 (1,152) power station: $424 (Reg. $499)
Elite 100 V2 (1,024Wh) power station: $449 (Reg. $899)
Elite 200 V2 (2,073.6Wh) power station: $799 (Reg. $1,199)
Elite 300 (3,014Wh) power station: $1,000 (Reg. $1,499)
Apex 300 (2,764.8Wh) power station: $1,399 (Reg. $1,699)
Elite 400 (3,840Wh) power station: $1,234 (Reg. $1,799)
Prime Day offers up to 37% ECOVACS robot mower savings – O1000 and A2000 LiDAR Pro models at new lows from $949, more
With the Amazon Prime Big Deal Days in full swing, we’re seeing ECOVACS robot lawn mowers getting up to 37% savings right now, with a top pick being the 1/4-acre O1000 LiDAR Pro model at a new all-time low price of $949.05 shipped , or its more advanced 1/2-acre A2000 LiDAR Pro model also at a new all-time low of $1,329.05 shipped . These two robots go for $1,500 and $2,000 at full price, which we previously saw only go as low as $999 and $1,399 with past discounts, but you’re getting more savings than ever here right now.
You can browse the full lineup of ECOVACS robot mower deals in our original coverage here .
Jump on Segway’s 43-mile Max G2 e-scooter with $370 Prime Day savings to $630, more
As part of the ongoing Amazon Fall Prime Day Sale , you can currently find Segway’s G2 Electric Scooter down at $629.99 shipped , and matching at the brand’s direct website . Down from $1,000 here, we’ve previously seen it go as low as $595 back during June’s Prime Day event, while other discounts usually kept things above $700 this year. Now, with this fall savings, you’re getting $370 cut from the tag for the second-lowest overall price we have tracked. You can also find a number of Segway’s other e-scooter deals rounded up together here , as well as all the deals on EVs, power stations, tools, and more collected into our Fall Prime Day Green Deals hub .
EGO’s carbon fiber 16-inch POWERLOAD trimmer + 8-inch edger Multi-Head combo kit hits new $364 low ($135 off), more
Save up to 45% on Worx tools during Fall Prime Day, like the 13A electric mulcher at a new $119 2026 low, more from $30
Prime Day offers Beatbot’s 2026 Sora 70 5-in-1 robotic pool cleaner back at its $999 low, more from $319 (Up to 35% off)
Anker’s Nebula Capsule 3 mini projector + laser counterpart starts from $360, or more premium projectors from $800
Fall Prime Day 2026 Green Deals: EVs, power stations, electric tools, smart devices, and much more
Best new Green Deals landing this week
The savings this week are also continuing to a collection of other markdowns. To the same tune as the offers above, these all help you take a more energy-conscious approach to your routine. Winter means you can lock in even better off-season price cuts on electric tools for the lawn while saving on EVs and tons of other gear.
Lectric’s Better-Than-Prime Sale cuts XPeak2 off-road e-bike bundle to new $1,299 low, more from $799
Velotric’s Fall Prime Day Sale offers first discount on new Summit 2 mixed-terrain smart e-bike for $1,999, more
Anker’s solar EufyCam S3 Pro 4K 2-cam kit at exclusive $420 (Reg. $550) + other cameras and smart locks from $150
Segway offers $200 extra savings when buying any two of these e-bikes (Up to $2,200 off)
Electrified Weekly – Yozma IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike exclusive $1,699 low ($700 off), early Prime deals on Anker SOLIX power stations, more
